row.name: Skyward Specialty Insurance Group Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=2 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.59 tightness=2.09 base_volume_vs_leg=1.83 base_volume_vs_avg=1.68
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 2 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.59 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 4.4% vs its 20-SMA, 6.2% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: Two recorded FAILs drive this below A: the base is only 2 sessions (outside Bonde's 3–20 minimum) with a giveback of 0.59 and tightness of 2.09, and the burst bar's range at 6.0% is only 0.77× the largest of the prior 5 bars, meaning it is not a genuine range expansion. On the chart the shaded base region is visibly just two bars with a wide red breakdown bar followed by the burst, confirming the measured looseness and short duration.
claude.key_risk: A two-session base with a 59% giveback and no range expansion means the consolidation never formed properly, leaving no orderly launch pad for follow-through.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst day's close (~63.30) or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest and price fades back toward the base high.
